AAFP Pregnancy Care: clinical guidance and practice resources
text: The American Academy of Family Physicians' hub for pregnancy, postpartum, and breastfeeding care. It summarizes USPSTF prenatal recommendations (including aspirin to prevent preeclampsia and blood pressure screening in pregnancy), postpartum planning tools, perinatal mental health resources, vaccine guidance in pregnancy, and patient education links.

title: USPSTF: Aspirin use to prevent preeclampsia and related morbidity and mortality
text: The US Preventive Services Task Force recommends daily low-dose aspirin after 12 weeks of pregnancy for pregnant people at high risk for preeclampsia, based on evidence of a substantial net benefit in reducing preeclampsia, preterm birth, small-for-gestational-age infants, and perinatal death. Kidney disease is one of the high-risk factors; whether to take aspirin and when to start is decided with the prenatal care team.

title: USPSTF: Screening for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
text: The US Preventive Services Task Force recommends screening for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy. Hypertensive disorders are a leading cause of maternal illness and death, and early identification provides substantial net benefit.

title: CDC HEAR HER campaign: urgent maternal warning signs
text: CDC campaign that helps pregnant and postpartum people recognize urgent maternal warning signs, during pregnancy and up to one year after birth, and encourages them to speak up and seek care when something feels wrong.

title: National Maternal Mental Health Hotline
text: Free, confidential 24/7 hotline from HRSA for pregnant and new parents who feel overwhelmed, anxious, or need support during pregnancy or after birth. Call or text 1-833-852-6262.
